+func cacheTLS(ctx context.Context, client *dagger.Client, base, flipt *dagger.Container, conf testConfig) func() error {
+	return func() error {
+		key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		cert := &x509.Certificate{
+			SerialNumber:          big.NewInt(time.Now().UnixNano()),
+			Subject:               pkix.Name{CommonName: "redis"},
+			NotBefore:             time.Now().Add(-time.Minute),
+			NotAfter:              time.Now().Add(time.Hour),
+			DNSNames:              []string{"redis"},
+			IsCA:                  true,
+			BasicConstraintsValid: true,
+			KeyUsage:              x509.KeyUsageCertSign | x509.KeyUsageDigitalSignature,
+			ExtKeyUsage:           []x509.ExtKeyUsage{x509.ExtKeyUsageServerAuth},
+		}
+		der, err := x509.CreateCertificate(rand.Reader, cert, cert, &key.PublicKey, key)
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		certPEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "CERTIFICATE", Bytes: der})
+		keyPEM := pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(key)})
+		redisService := client.Container().
+			From("redis:alpine").
+			WithNewFile("/tls/redis.crt", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(certPEM)}).
+			WithNewFile("/tls/redis.key", dagger.ContainerWithNewFileOpts{Contents: string(keyPEM)}).
+			WithExposedPort(6379).
+			WithExec([]string{"redis-server", "--port", "0", "--tls-port", "6379", "--tls-cert-file", "/tls/redis.crt", "--tls-key-file", "/tls/redis.key", "--tls-ca-cert-file", "/tls/redis.crt", "--tls-auth-clients", "no"})
+		flipt = flipt.
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG").
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_ENABLED", "true").
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_BACKEND", "redis").
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_HOST", "redis").
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_REQUIRE_TLS", "true").
+			WithEnvVariable("FLIPT_CACHE_REDIS_CA_CERT_BYTES", string(certPEM)).
+			WithServiceBinding("redis", redisService.AsService())
+		return suite(ctx, "api", base, flipt.WithExec(nil), conf)()
+	}
+}
